12.0.en: He learned the basics of bike [[mechanics:mechanics]] and carefully fixed small broken pieces of [[electronics:electronics]].
12.0.zh: 他学了自行车机械的基础知识，还细心修好了几件坏掉的小电子器件。

12.1.en: Evening [[maths:maths]] help made fast, silent [[arithmetic:arithmetic]] feel easy and almost fun.
12.1.zh: 晚间的数学辅导让快速心算变得轻松，甚至有点好玩。

12.2.en: For [[geometry:geometry]] homework he drew shapes, then solved five easy [[algebra:algebra]] problems before bed.
12.2.zh: 几何作业画图形，睡前再解出五道简单的代数题。

12.3.en: He previewed basic [[calculus:calculus]] ideas [[plus:plus]] a few graphs before the new term began.
12.3.zh: 新学期开始前，他预习了基础微积分概念和一些图表。

12.4.en: He added each small [[sum:sum]] correctly, and the final [[total:total]] was checked with his roommate.
12.4.zh: 每笔小数都加得准确，最后的总和还和室友核对过。

12.5.en: Two study groups even decided to [[merge:merge]] and work out one long, hard [[equation:equation]] together.
12.5.zh: 两个学习小组干脆合并，一起解那道又长又难的方程。

13.0.en: During finals week, Lin and Mei had [[identical:identical]] schedules, [[minus:minus]] a few tiny changes.
13.0.zh: 期末考试周，林和梅的日程一模一样，只差几处小小的变动。

13.1.en: Their maths teacher showed how to [[subtract:subtract]] old scores, and how small daily gains [[multiply:multiply]] into a high mark.
13.1.zh: 数学老师教他们怎样扣减旧分数，也讲了每天一点小进步怎样成倍累积成高分。

13.2.en: They saved the [[remainder:remainder]] of their lunch money by setting firm daily [[parameter:parameters]].
13.2.zh: 他们定下严格的每日花销参数，把剩下的午餐钱省了下来。

13.3.en: Late [[night:night]] winds were the only [[variable:variables]] that felt [[odd:odd]] in the [[dorm:dorm]].
13.3.zh: 深夜的宿舍里，只有呼呼的风声这一个变量让人觉得古怪。

13.4.en: Coffee sales seemed to [[quadruple:quadruple]] as tired students faced [[multiple:multiple]] hard deadlines.
13.4.zh: 疲惫的学生们面对一个接一个的死线，咖啡销量似乎翻了四倍。

13.5.en: Late at [[night:night]], Sam drew an [[approximately:approximately]] clear study [[diagram:diagram]] on the whiteboard.
13.5.zh: 深夜里，山姆在白板上画了一张大致清晰的学习图表。

14.0.en: Sam filled a large [[matrix:matrix]] with key dates, right beside a neat red [[rectangle:rectangle]].
14.0.zh: 山姆在整齐的红色矩形旁，把关键日期填进一个大矩阵里。

14.1.en: Anna added a small blue [[triangle:triangle]] and a bold black [[diagonal:diagonal]] for fun.
14.1.zh: 安娜凑趣添了个蓝色小三角和一条黑色粗对角线。

14.2.en: They played a quick [[round:round]] of the game, sticking lucky [[dot:dots]] on each finished task.
14.2.zh: 他们快速玩了一轮，每完成一项任务就贴上一枚幸运小圆点。

14.3.en: Mei bought a soft foam [[sphere:sphere]] and an ice-cream [[cone:cone]] after class.
14.3.zh: 下课后梅买了个软泡沫球和一个蛋筒冰淇淋。

14.4.en: Evening rain tapped on the bright [[canteen:canteen]] windows while kettles sang low.
14.4.zh: 傍晚的雨敲着食堂明亮的窗户，水壶在一旁低声鸣唱。

14.5.en: No one knew the full [[extent:extent]] of their tiredness until scores turned to cold [[decimal:decimals]].
14.5.zh: 直到分数变成冰冷的小数，大家才知道自己累到了什么地步。

15.0.en: A large [[proportion:proportion]] of freshmen worried about the high failing [[rate:rate]] in [[physics:physics]].
15.0.zh: 很大比例的新生都担心物理课的高挂科率。

15.1.en: Lin explained her simple study [[ratio:ratio]] with only a [[fraction:fraction]] of her usual jokes.
15.1.zh: 林解释她那套简单的学习配比时，玩笑话只讲了平时的一小部分。

15.2.en: Sam weighed his tea on a small table [[scale:scale]], saving one last [[ounce:ounce]] for the night before the exam.
15.2.zh: 山姆用小台秤称茶叶，省下最后一盎司留给考前那晚。

15.3.en: The [[library:library]] air had a heavy warm [[density:density]], close to ninety degrees [[fahrenheit:Fahrenheit]].
15.3.zh: 图书馆的空气又闷又稠，温度接近华氏九十度。

15.4.en: Old lamps with weak [[mercury:mercury]] light needed fresh, strong [[battery:batteries]].
15.4.zh: 水银灯光昏暗的旧台灯，得换上电力十足的新电池。

15.5.en: The loose old socket carrying 240 [[volt:volts]] seemed to [[radiate:radiate]] heat across the cold desk.
15.5.zh: 那个通着二百四十伏电的松旧插座，好像把热气一直散到冰冷的桌面上。

16.0.en: New desk lamps [[emit:emit]] soft white light through clean [[transparent:transparent]] covers.
16.0.zh: 新台灯透过干净的透明灯罩，洒下柔和的白光。

16.1.en: Tired voices echoed in the [[hollow:hollow]] hall while cold [[night:night]] air, sharp with [[ozone:ozone]], drifted inside.
16.1.zh: 疲惫的说话声在空荡荡的大厅里回响，清冽如雨后臭氧的夜风一阵阵灌进来。

16.2.en: Sleep pulled at them with heavy [[gravity:gravity]], but friendship cut through the psychological [[friction:friction]].
16.2.zh: 睡意像沉重的引力拉扯着他们，但友情化解了心里的摩擦。

16.3.en: Their [[eccentric:eccentric]] club leader took care never to [[displace:displace]] anyone from a group seat.
16.3.zh: 他们那位古怪的社团团长从不挤占任何人的座位。

16.4.en: Warm soup helped the stress slowly [[melt:melt]] and the long worries quietly [[dissolve:dissolve]] away.
16.4.zh: 一碗热汤下肚，压力慢慢融化，积攒已久的烦恼也悄悄消散。

16.5.en: Old bikes might [[rust:rust]] outdoors, but new ideas began to [[ferment:ferment]] in young minds.
16.5.zh: 旧自行车搁在露天里会生锈，新的想法却在年轻人脑中慢慢发酵。

17.0.en: Sam tried to [[dilute:dilute]] his black coffee before the tart [[acid:acid]] taste fully woke him.
17.0.zh: 山姆把黑咖啡兑水冲淡，免得那股酸味把自己彻底呛醒。

17.1.en: The basement air felt [[noxious:noxious]], and the old radio gave off only [[static:static]] noise.
17.1.zh: 地下室的空气呛人，旧收音机只发出静电噪音。

17.2.en: The cold tables looked dull and [[inert:inert]], yet carried an [[inherent:inherent]] calm perfect for study.
17.2.zh: 冰冷的书桌看着死气沉沉，却自有一种天生适合学习的安静。

17.3.en: Mei copied one neat math [[formula:formula]] and each small [[component:component]] onto bright cards.
17.3.zh: 梅把那条工整的数学公式连同每个组成部分，都抄上了彩色卡片。

17.4.en: Together they helped Anna [[compose:compose]] short chants and [[blend:blend]] jokes with warm encouragement.
17.4.zh: 大家一起帮安娜编短口号，把玩笑和暖心鼓励揉在一起。

17.5.en: Chuckles floated down the [[narrow:narrow]] corridors as the lights glowed warm and [[steady:steady]].
17.5.zh: 轻轻的笑声顺着窄走廊飘远，灯光稳稳地亮着，暖洋洋的。

18.0.en: Lin trusted basic study [[theory:theory]] more than sudden late-night [[empirical:empirical]] tips.
18.0.zh: 比起深夜临时拼凑的经验之谈，林更相信基础的学习理论。

18.1.en: Sam wanted [[practical:practical]] sleep plans instead of any stiff old [[doctrine:doctrine]].
18.1.zh: 山姆只想要实用的睡眠计划，不要那些僵硬的老教条。

18.2.en: Good self [[discipline:discipline]] and a clear wall [[timetable:timetable]] kept their evenings calm and [[steady:steady]].
18.2.zh: 良好的自律加墙上一目了然的时间表，让他们的夜晚过得安稳踏实。

18.3.en: The busy autumn [[curriculum:curriculum]] ended with a vibrant evening [[seminar:seminar]] about [[campus:campus]] life.
18.3.zh: 紧凑的秋季课程，以一场热闹的校园生活晚间研讨会收尾。

18.4.en: A busy online [[forum:forum]] carried the club's new [[spring:spring]] [[syllabus:syllabus]] for beginners.
18.4.zh: 热闹的网上论坛贴出了社团面向新手的春季新大纲。

18.5.en: Freshmen reviewed their [[rudimentary:rudimentary]] maths and worked through a few [[elementary:elementary]] word lists.
18.5.zh: 新生们把基础数学过了一遍，又啃了几份最入门的单词表。

18.6.en: Every morning, Lin packed his [[backpack:backpack]] with lunch and one red book.
18.6.zh: 每天早晨，林都把午餐和一本红皮书装进双肩背包。

18.7.en: Sam hung his own [[artwork:artwork]] beside the classroom door for the show.
18.7.zh: 萨姆把自己的艺术作品挂在教室门边，准备参展。

19.0.en: Late-night talks brought [[profound:profound]] comfort before the final [[compulsory:compulsory]] math review.
19.0.zh: 深夜的长谈带来深深的慰藉，随后便是最后的必修数学复习。

19.1.en: Basic coding remained a [[prerequisite:prerequisite]] for everyone, with no harsh [[selective:selective]] entry test.
19.1.zh: 基础编程对所有人都是先修条件，但不设任何苛刻的筛选式入门考试。

19.2.en: Mei picked a fun music [[elective:elective]] to balance each heavy written [[assignment:assignment]].
19.2.zh: 梅选了一门有趣的音乐选修课，来平衡繁重的书面作业。

19.3.en: They stayed up to [[revise:revise]] notes and [[consult:consult]] [[senior:senior]] students for clear guidance.
19.3.zh: 他们熬夜温习笔记，还向学长学姐请教，寻求清晰的指点。

19.4.en: Lin learned to [[skim:skim]] long pages quickly and then [[scrutinise:scrutinise]] the key examples closely.
19.4.zh: 林学会先快速略读长页内容，再仔细推敲关键例题。

19.5.en: Anna helped them [[recite:recite]] new terms, while Sam tried to [[dictate:dictate]] short sentences.
19.5.zh: 安娜帮大家背诵新词，山姆则试着口述短句。

20.0.en: Before the big [[examination:examination]], they took one quiet practice [[test:test]] together in the [[dorm:dorm]].
20.0.zh: 大考前，他们在宿舍里一起安安静静做了一次模拟测验。

20.1.en: The short morning [[quiz:quiz]] felt easy after our long group [[presentation:presentation]] practice.
20.1.zh: 练了那么久的分组展示之后，早上那场小测验显得轻轻松松。

20.2.en: The teacher warned them never to [[plagiarise:plagiarise]] and to [[print:print]] only their own honest work.
20.2.zh: 老师警告他们绝不许抄袭，打印上交的必须是自己的诚实作业。

20.3.en: [[senior:senior]] students showed a short [[thesis:thesis]] and a neat model [[paper:paper]] as guides.
20.3.zh: 学长学姐们拿出一份短篇毕业论文和一份规范的范文给大家做参考。

20.4.en: Nobody wrote a long [[dissertation:dissertation]], but everyone fixed each [[chapter:chapter]] [[heading:heading]] with care.
20.4.zh: 没人写长篇学位论文，但每个人都认真改好了各章标题。

20.5.en: From the very [[outset:outset]], Mei caught the [[gist:gist]] of every lesson quickly.
20.5.zh: 从一开始，梅就能迅速抓住每节课的要点。

21.0.en: Each member shared an honest [[opinion:opinion]] and tried to [[introduce:introduce]] one helpful method.
21.0.zh: 每位成员都坦诚分享了自己的看法，还介绍了一种有用的方法。

21.1.en: They kept one useful [[reference:reference]] book and learned how to [[cite:cite]] sources correctly.
21.1.zh: 他们备了一本有用的参考书，也学会了正确引用资料来源。

21.2.en: Good questions could [[elicit:elicit]] fresh thoughts, and one perfect [[quote:quote]] went up on the wall.
21.2.zh: 好问题能引出新的想法，一句绝妙的引言还被贴上了墙。

21.3.en: Sam learned to [[extract:extract]] key lines and write a short, clear [[abstract:abstract]] every day.
21.3.zh: 山姆学会摘取关键句，每天写一段简短清晰的摘要。

21.4.en: Mei wrote a brief morning [[summary:summary]], but refused to simply [[assume:assume]] an easy win.
21.4.zh: 梅每天早晨写一份简短总结，但绝不轻易假定胜利唾手可得。

21.5.en: Near [[midnight:midnight]], snow began to fall gently over the silent rooftops.
21.5.zh: 快午夜时，雪开始静静落在寂静的屋顶上。

22.0.en: Teachers would never [[presume:presume]] cheating, nor idly [[suppose:suppose]] a fiasco without checking the facts.
22.0.zh: 老师们绝不凭空假定有人作弊，也不会不作核实就猜想会出大乱子。

22.1.en: Lin put forward one bold new [[hypothesis:hypothesis]] and one [[quiet:quiet]], simple [[postulate:postulate]] for her friends to test.
22.1.zh: 林提出一个大胆的新假说，还有一个安安静静、简单明了的公设，让朋友们去检验。

22.2.en: Freshmen loved to [[speculate:speculate]] about scores, but none could truly [[predict:predict]] the results.
22.2.zh: 新生们爱猜测分数，可谁也说不准真正的结果。

22.3.en: Sharp eyes could [[perceive:perceive]] small changes and [[detect:detect]] rising stress early.
22.3.zh: 眼尖的人能察觉细微的变化，早早发现悄悄升高的压力。

22.4.en: Anna could [[discern:discern]] tired smiles, and stayed fully [[conscious:conscious]] of time slipping past.
22.4.zh: 安娜能辨出那些强撑的笑，也始终清楚时间在一分一秒地溜走。

22.5.en: Seniors [[reckon:reckon]] late-night effort useful, and [[deem:deem]] [[steady:steady]] sleep just as important.
22.5.zh: 学长们认为深夜用功有用，也把安稳的睡眠看得同样重要。

23.0.en: Short notes often [[imply:implied]] hidden worry, and called for calm, [[deliberate:deliberate]] evening talks.
23.0.zh: 简短的纸条常暗示着藏起来的忧愁，需要心平气和、深思熟虑的夜谈来化解。

23.1.en: Lin would [[represent:represent]] their [[dorm:dorm]] team and [[insist:insist]] on fair, calm voting.
23.1.zh: 林代表宿舍队出战，并坚持公平冷静地投票。

23.2.en: Tired as they were, they chose to [[persist:persist]] until they had fully [[comprehend:comprehended]] every rule.
23.2.zh: 虽然疲惫，他们仍选择坚持，直到把每条规则都完全弄懂。

23.3.en: Tutors helped them quickly [[diagnose:diagnose]] weak points and safely [[infer:infer]] better study paths.
23.3.zh: 导师帮他们快速找出薄弱环节，再稳妥地推断出更合适的学习路径。

23.4.en: Sam could [[deduce:deduce]] answers from hints, using one funny food [[analogy:analogy]] each [[night:night]].
23.4.zh: 山姆能顺着提示推断答案，每晚还配上一个好玩的食物类比。

23.5.en: [[spring:Spring]] [[breeze:breeze]] carried fresh [[blossom:blossom]] [[scent:scent]] through the open courtyard doors.
23.5.zh: 春风带着新鲜的花香，穿过敞开的院门吹了进来。

paraZh.12: 从机械到微积分，数理功课稳步推进。
paraZh.13: 期末周林梅结伴复习，深夜苦中作乐。
paraZh.14: 画图表贴圆点，雨夜食堂苦中带甜。
paraZh.15: 担心物理挂科率，闷热图书馆换电池。
paraZh.16: 灯下夜读，热汤化开疲惫与烦恼。
paraZh.17: 兑咖啡抄公式，笑声暖灯下互相打气。
paraZh.18: 定自律计划迎研讨，背包里装满干劲。
paraZh.19: 选课温书练背诵，考前备战有条不紊。
paraZh.20: 诚信模考抓要点，大考从容不迫。
paraZh.21: 分享方法引名言写摘要，雪夜各自沉淀。
paraZh.22: 大胆假设细心观察，压力中互相照应。
paraZh.23: 坚持弄懂规则，春风花信中迎来转机。
